race.comment: Hasn't taken long for the decision to extend this race from 1600m to 2000m to be justified with a full field and some well-performed types putting their hand up for a start in the first edition at 2000m. SABAJ (2) was a popular winner of an 1800m G3 race at Flemington on Melbourne Cup Day. While that was his first win since claiming the Cranbourne Cup on this weekend last year, the only time he'd been out to 2000m he finished fourth in the G1 Australian Cup. TOO DARN DISCREET (4) pulled up with an issue two back, but she proved she'd taken no ill effects from it with a luckless second in a 2000m G2 for mares last time out. Only needs to hold that form. MILITARY ACADEMY (11) has been big odds in two Aus runs, but ran a much improved third last time out and might have more improvement to come than a few of these. AL DUCA (5) finished seventh last time out over 1800m at Flemington. Steps up in distance today. Among the leading chances in this company.
